name: desktop-adobe-mcp
description: Safely control local Photoshop 2020 and Illustrator 2020 through Windows COM MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Control local Photoshop and Illustrator with guarded COM automation.
interface.longDescription: Installs pinned local MCP runtimes for Photoshop 2020 and Illustrator 2020, discovers Windows installations dynamically, and keeps arbitrary-script operations behind explicit approval prompts.
defaultPrompt: 检查本机 Adobe MCP 状态，并告诉我可用的 Photoshop 与 Illustrator 操作。
在 Photoshop 中按我的要求编辑当前文档，保存前先征求确认。
在 Illustrator 中按我的要求修改当前图稿，高风险脚本执行前先确认。
